title: Producer-authored error text in the causal record is redacted for known secrets but not value-free
outcome: Producer-authored error text in the causal record is redacted for known secrets but not value-free
acceptance: A decision recorded by the TermAl coordinator on whether producer-authored diagnostics (an Engram remote error body's code and message, and an Engram CLI's stderr detail) may enter the persisted and rendered causal record as received text, and, if not, a change that keeps them out of the causal record without changing any decision that reads the transport error's message.
